name: spidi-race
description: Arcade-Rennspiel im Browser, inspiriert von Need for Speed II SE

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p shared --noEmit
